system.description:
Sparking Flail · cast at C-Rank to S-Rank · no type

A haze around you: the chosen hostile creature can't see through it, and you're fully obscured from it.

Chain 1: your first weapon or Taijutsu attack each turn has +1 critical threat range.

Chain 2: on a critical hit, invisibility and +20 speed until the end of the turn.
system.summary: A haze around you: the chosen hostile creature can't see through it, and you're fully obscured from it. Chain 1: your first weapon or Taijutsu attack each turn has +1 critical threat range. Chain 2: on a critical hit, invisibility and +20 speed until the end of the turn.

rules.text: The haze fills your weapon's range around you and follows you; the chosen creature (one more per rank above C) can't see through it.
Chain 1: your first weapon or Taijutsu attack each turn has a +1 bonus to its critical threat range.
Chain 2: when you score a critical hit, you become invisible and gain +20 speed until the end of the current turn.
